payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the model significantly improves upon the previous state-of-the-art in various metrics, particularly in F1-scores for implicit and explicit discourse relations.

claims.text: The model outperforms previous state-of-the-art systems, achieving an improvement of over 7% in macro-average F1-score for implicit relations.
The full model shows a performance boost of 3.02 in macro F1-score for implicit relations compared to the baseline.
The paragraph-level model achieves F1-score improvements of 6 points on Comparison and 7 points on Temporal relations compared to the best previous systems.
